verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Sketch's first-party CLI `sketchtool`, which documents creating assets with a single command. That shows Sketch itself can produce assets, but nothing confirms the formats, per-layer presets, scales, or slices the story asks for. missing for 10: documented PNG/SVG/PDF export formats, per-layer export presets, export scale options, slice support, in-app export UI documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can export production assets — PNG, SVG, PDF, and more — with per-layer presets, scales, and slices

citations.quote: Create assets with a single command with the Sketch command-line interface `sketchtool`.
